app.name: Måltidsplanlegger
app.tagline: High-protein meals for the whole family

week.title: Week plan
week.description: Here the app creates a high-protein week plan for the whole family, tailored to each adult's protein target.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.description: Here the app builds the shopping list automatically from the week plan.

pantry.title: At home
pantry.description: Here you keep track of what you have at home and what has run out.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Here you find all recipes, with search, filters and favourites.

settings.title: Settings

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language only applies to this device.

settings.recalculated: The portions in the week plan were recalculated.
settings.replaced_one: {{count}} dish in the week plan no longer fitted and was replaced. You can undo it on the week plan.
settings.replaced_other: {{count}} dishes in the week plan no longer fitted and were replaced. You can undo it on the week plan.

profile.title: My profile
profile.text: Your protein target. The week plan is recalculated from today when you save.

household.title: Household
household.selfTarget: You · {{target}} g – change under My profile
household.selfNoTarget: You – set your target under My profile

autoPlan.title: Make new week plan automatically
autoPlan.day: Next week's plan is made on
autoPlan.hint: The plan is made the first time you open the app on or after {{day}}. Only empty meals are filled.
autoPlan.offHint: When turned on, the app makes next week's plan for you.

split.title: Meals and protein
split.text: Turn off meals you don't eat – the protein is then spread over the others. The percentage is how much of the daily protein target each meal should cover.

settings.replacedUndone: The dishes are back in the week plan

install.cardTitle: Add the app to your home screen
install.cardText: It then opens like a regular app, straight from your phone.
install.installed: The app is installed on this device.
install.installedToast: The app was added to your home screen
install.promptText: Tap “Install” to add the app to your home screen.
install.iosTitle: How to do it on iPhone and iPad
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow pointing up) in the browser.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add” in the top right corner.
install.manualStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.manualNote: Don't see the option? Then this browser doesn't support installing. Try Chrome, Edge or Samsung Internet, or Safari on iPhone.

recipes.searchPlaceholder: Search for a dish or ingredient …
recipes.empty: No matching recipes. Try another search or filter.

detail.nutritionMissing: Some ingredients have no nutrition data, so the numbers may be too low.

form.notFound: Recipe not found. It may have been deleted.
form.name: Name
form.servingsHint: How many adult portions the amounts are for.
form.errorSummary: Something is missing. Check the marked fields.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.amounts: Enter an amount greater than 0 for every ingredient.

unsaved.title: Discard changes?
unsaved.description: You have changes that are not saved. They will be lost if you leave.

form.omittableHint: For anyone who doesn't tolerate it, e.g. pepper or cinnamon

newIngredient.title: New ingredient
newIngredient.name: Name
newIngredient.hint: Fill in both protein and kcal to get nutrition values. Otherwise the recipe is marked “Nutrition missing”.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteConfirm.text: The recipe disappears from the week plan and your favourites.

week.favoritesHint: If there are too few favourites, the rest is filled with other dishes.
week.replaceHint: Replaces everything from today. You will be asked first.

replaceConfirm.title: Make a new week plan?
replaceConfirm.description: Everything planned from today on will be replaced. You can undo it afterwards.

week.emptyText: Tap “Make week plan” to fill the whole week, or pick dishes yourself below. You can also mix.
week.noPeople: The family isn't set up yet, so the app can't work out portions and protein targets.

notes.sameProteinSource: Same protein source as the day before

toast.tooFewFavorites_one: Too few favourites: {{count}} meal got another dish.
toast.tooFewFavorites_other: Too few favourites: {{count}} meals got other dishes.

meal.leftoversHint: Leftovers from {{day}}’s dinner. The amount is included when the dinner is cooked.
meal.eatingOutText: You are eating out. This meal is not counted in the day’s protein target.
meal.skippedText: This meal is skipped. It is not counted in the day’s protein target. You can fill it in again at any time.

pick.title: {{slot}}, {{day}}
pick.description: The numbers show the day’s protein if you pick the dish.

week.replaceFavorites: Make new week plan – favourites only

summary.title: {{day}} is planned.
summary.weekDays: Everyone reaches their target on {{ok}} of {{total}} days.

week.noTarget: Add a protein target for {{names}} so the app can adjust the portions.

approve.title: Approve week {{week}}
approve.intro: Choose “Have” for what you have at home. What you need to buy goes on the shopping list.
approve.fromToday: From today on. What has been eaten is already bought.
approve.usedLastWeek: Used last week – do you still have some?
approve.staplesHint: Count as “Have”. Choose “Buy” for anything that has run out.
approve.add_one: Add {{count}} item to the shopping list
approve.add_other: Add {{count}} items to the shopping list

homeFirst.label: Use what we have at home first
homeFirst.hint: Add your items under Home, and I’ll use them in the plan.

swapList.title: Shopping list – {{name}} ({{day}})
swapList.intro: This is how the shopping list for week {{week}} changes.
swapList.more: On the list – the amount grows

household.targetInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 500, or leave the field empty.
household.lunchAtHome: Eats lunch at home on weekdays

dislikes.label: Doesn't like:
dislikes.title: What doesn't {{name}} like?
dislikes.description: The app tries to avoid dishes with these.

notTolerated.label: Doesn't tolerate:
notTolerated.title: What doesn't {{name}} tolerate?
notTolerated.description: Dishes with these are never suggested for meals {{name}} eats – unless they can be left out or swapped for something milder.
notTolerated.hint: Spice blends and sauces count too: chili also covers taco seasoning and tikka paste.
notTolerated.omitHint: Take out their portion before adding it, or serve it on the side.
notTolerated.ingredientLabel: Does it contain anything the household doesn't tolerate?
notTolerated.ingredientHint: Tick what it contains, or choose "None of these". Without an answer, dishes with this ingredient are not suggested.

week.outTitle: Fixed days you don't eat dinner at home
week.outHint: The next day gets a quick lunch instead of leftovers.
week.cheatTitle: Cheat days – the evening snack can be a treat

meals.title: Which meals do you eat?
meals.hint: Meals you don't eat are not planned and don't count towards the protein target. The protein is spread over the others.
meals.minOne: At least one of breakfast, lunch and dinner must be on.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}} from the household?
removeConfirm.text: Allergies and what {{name}} doesn't like or doesn't tolerate are removed too.

welcome.title: Welcome to Måltidsplanlegger
welcome.text: The app makes week plans where every adult reaches their own protein target. A few short questions first – everything can be skipped and changed later.
welcome.name: What's your name?
welcome.exampleText: Just want to see how it works? Anna and Ola (120 and 140 g protein) and two children get a finished week plan. Everything can be changed later.

protein.title: How much protein do you need per day?
protein.titleNamed: How much protein do you need per day, {{name}}?
protein.label: Your protein target

household.title: Who eats with you?
household.text: Add the others in your household. Children get half a portion and have no protein target.

food.title: Is there food you don't want?
food.text: The app never suggests dishes with it.

week.title: What does your week look like?

done.title: All set!
done.text: Everything can be changed under Settings.
done.textAgain: The week plan is adjusted from today when you save.

allergens.label: Allergies and intolerances:
allergens.title: Allergies – {{name}}
allergens.description: Dishes with these are never suggested for meals {{name}} eats.
allergens.lactoseHint: Lactose-free food still contains milk protein. Choose “Milk (allergy)” for a milk allergy, and “Lactose (intolerance)” if lactose-free food is fine.
allergens.disclaimer: The app is an aid. Always check the label – contents can vary between brands.
allergens.wizardNote: Allergies, food someone doesn't tolerate and dislikes are set for each person. Dishes with allergens or food someone doesn't tolerate are never suggested. The app is an aid – always check the label.
allergens.containsNone: Contains none of the common allergens.
allergens.noSafeDish: No dish fits all the allergies and food someone doesn't tolerate

pickAnyway.title: Pick anyway?
pickAnyway.description: {{dish}} contains {{allergens}}. It is not suitable for {{names}}.

ingredient.label: Allergens
ingredient.hint: Choose all that are in the item, hidden ones too (e.g. soy sauce = gluten). If you choose nothing, it says “allergens not stated”.

undoAnyway.description: {{dishes}} was replaced because it doesn’t fit the allergies or what someone doesn’t tolerate. Bring it back anyway?

shopping.empty: The shopping list is empty. Type items above, or approve a week plan.
shopping.addHint: Write freely. Separate items with commas or new lines – the app sorts them.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.sectionHint: The app remembers the section next time.
sheet.stapleHint: Staples are listed without an amount.

shopping.notInPlan: No longer needed in the plan

pantry.addLabel: Add items you have at home
pantry.addHint: Write freely. Separate items with commas or new lines.
pantry.alreadyOnList: {{name}} is already on the shopping list
pantry.emptyState: What you tick off in the shop lands here by itself. You can also type items or pick them from the list.

pick.title: Pick from the list
pick.intro: Tap what you have at home. Tap again to remove.
